questions: Is the cost of swapping P_i and P_{i+1} always exactly i, regardless of the values being swapped, or does it depend on the positions after previous swaps?
When we 'sort P in order', does that mean strictly ascending order (1,2,...,N)?
Can we perform multiple operations simultaneously or only one at a time?
Is the goal to minimize total cost, and if multiple sequences achieve the same minimal cost, are we just required to output that minimum?
Are we allowed to choose the same i multiple times in succession?
Does the cost accumulate per swap operation, or is there a discount for swapping adjacent pairs in a certain pattern?
Should the output be an integer, and are there constraints on the maximum cost value?
Is there any time or memory complexity requirement implied, or just correctness?
